Living full-time in a RV or Camprvan means that you have to be prepared to skee-daddle fast for safety! Do you have a good back up plan? I got creeped out with some friends camping in Nevada and we had to leave at 2am. Options were scarce and the only overnight spot I knew of was 20 minutes in the wrong direction! What did I do? I'll tell you about Trucker Path in today's video!
